an4.57:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling among the Koliyans near the Koliyan town named Sajjanela.
an4.57:1.2: Then, in the morning, the Blessed One dressed, took his bowl and robe, and went to the residence of the Koliyan daughter Suppavāsā, where he sat down in the prepared seat.
an4.57:1.3: Then the Koliyan daughter Suppavāsā, with her own hand, served and satisfied the Blessed One with various kinds of delicious food.
an4.57:1.4: When the Blessed One had finished eating and had put away his bowl, the Koliyan daughter Suppavāsā sat down to one side.
an4.57:1.5: The Blessed One then said to her:
an4.57:2.1: “Suppavāsā, a female noble disciple who gives food gives the recipients four things.
an4.57:2.3: She gives life, beauty, happiness, and strength.
an4.57:2.4: (1) Having given life, she partakes of life, whether celestial or human.
an4.57:2.5: (2) Having given beauty, she partakes of beauty, whether celestial or human.
an4.57:2.6: (3) Having given happiness, she partakes of happiness, whether celestial or human.
an4.57:2.7: (4) Having given strength, she partakes of strength, whether celestial or human.
an4.57:2.8: Suppavāsā, a female noble disciple who gives food gives the recipients these four things.”
